summary: Frontend-only final verification for Obserra EIOS. Login OK. Risk (FAIR) page NO LONGER white-screens: all required data-testids render (fair-dashboard, fair-formula, fair-kpis, fair-deductions, fair-by-area, fair-lec [SVG], fair-risk-table, fair-feeds, fair-kpi-refs, fair-references). fin-waterfall renders SVG. fin-trend renders SVG with peer band. LEFT NAV categories match spec exactly (Risk / Cyber / AI Governance / Third-Party Risk / Reporting + Audit/Admin/Account). No 'Cyber Risk' or 'Dashboards' categories. Spot-check navigations to Risk (FAIR), Control Monitoring (/app/controls), Remediations (/app/decisions), Benchmarking (/app/benchmark) all render their own pages (unique h1s: 'Risk', 'Continuous Control Monitoring', 'Recommendations & Decisions', 'Peer Benchmarking'). Connect-all-catalog flips 0/8 -> 8/8. Board report background job POST /advisor/board-report + polling GET rendered a complete report at ~t+45s with all 7 required sections (Executive Summary, Business Impact Analysis, Risk Analysis, Financial Exposure, Advanced FAIR, Unremediated Risk Acceptance, Recommendations). Board pack PDF downloads (obserra-board-pack.pdf, 227KB). fin-reminder-cadence changes and saves with 'Financial model updated' toast. Industry Auto-Detect flow: switching to Healthcare surfaces fin-industry-suggest, clicking it reverts to Technology; final reset to Technology confirmed. NOTE: request mentioned testid 'fair-waterfall' but actual code uses 'fin-waterfall' — treated as spec typo; the chart itself renders correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: ChartErrorBoundary triggers and shows 'Chart unavailable.' fallback for the horizontal BarChart at CyberRisk.jsx line ~325. Console still emits 'Expected ref to be a function... at markRef' (Recharts/React19 ref shape mismatch). Other charts (fair-lec, fin-waterfall, fin-trend) render fine via ChartBox. The ChartBox width-cloning fix works for most charts but this specific BarChart (layout=vertical with dynamic height) still throws. Users see a small 'Chart unavailable.' placeholder instead of the intended per-risk P10-P90 bar band.

action_items: Investigate why the vertical BarChart in FinancialBasis 'Per-risk uncertainty · P10 → P90 band' still trips the Recharts markRef ref error inside ChartBox even though sibling charts (LineChart, ComposedChart, waterfall BarChart) render. Likely a child element within that specific BarChart (YAxis with type='category' or the layered Bar with a ref) — try replacing with the same recipe used for fair-waterfall, or memoize the children so cloneElement doesn't re-mount, or omit ResponsiveContainer descendants that pass string refs.

Fix spec/testid drift: main agent's task doc references 'fair-waterfall' but code uses data-testid='fin-waterfall' (CyberRisk.jsx L323). Either update spec or rename to fair-waterfall for consistency with fair-* group.
critical_code_review_comments: ChartBox.jsx clones children with fixed width/height — works for most Recharts primitives but the vertical BarChart still fails; consider using a key on cloneElement or memoizing to avoid remount thrash, or wrap each chart individually.
Board Report modal auto-fires generation on open (no explicit 'Generate' button seen in modal DOM) — good UX but the request implied a manual 'Generate' action; keep in mind for future spec.

'Connect all' toast is emitted but visually the sonner toast container was empty by the time DOM was polled (5s wait) — count-change is authoritative; consider explicit aria-live region for testability.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (1 chart falls back to 'Chart unavailable' placeholder; page itself renders and all other flows pass)

seed_data_creation: Catalog connectors were connected (0/8 -> 8/8) via one-click Connect all. Industry temporarily set to Healthcare then reset to Technology. fin-reminder-cadence toggled 60 <-> 90 (final value 90 or as-selected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_37 confirms iteration_37-blocking white-screen crash is FIXED. FAIR page renders. Only residual issue: the 'Per-risk uncertainty' horizontal BarChart inside FinancialBasis still triggers ChartErrorBoundary (Chart unavailable placeholder). Correct route mapping: Control Monitoring => /app/controls; Remediations => /app/decisions; Benchmarking => /app/benchmark (not the labels lowercased). Board Report modal at /app auto-generates on open; report completes in ~40-50s. board-pack-btn lives on Risk (FAIR) page. Test tour: click 'Skip' after first login and after page navs (tour re-shows).
rca of the issue: React 19's reconciler passes only function/object refs to markRef; Recharts children (especially the vertical BarChart YAxis/Bar) still forward string-ish refs somewhere internally. ChartBox bypasses ResponsiveContainer (which was the primary offender in iteration_37) and works for most charts, but this specific chart's internal component still hits markRef. ChartErrorBoundary correctly catches and renders 'Chart unavailable.' fallback — no white-screen but user-visible degraded rendering.
